purpose: Targeted generic-only A/B for Order 106 hypothesis 3 after preserving and auditing the v93 failure.
change_scope: One generic prompt-policy change for instructions that explicitly require source-code execution: read relevant source, use model-selected command.run for a finite baseline before the first mutation, then use it again for finite post-edit verification. Interactive programs receive generic bounded-test guidance. No task identity, filename, answer, command argv, tool argument, action schema, or execution route is injected.

protocol.dynamic_instruction_schema_or_stage_forc: conditional generic code-execution guidance only; no schema, action, or argument forcing
protocol.on_failure: Preserve and audit this final hypothesis-3 A/B. If it does not produce a valid clean pass, mark Order 106 task_blocked and immediately advance to the next ledger entry. Do not try a fourth hypothesis or rerun v94 unchanged.

implementation_evidence.parent_diagnosis: v93 correctly exposed command.run in the initial seven-action tool surface, but Qwen never selected it. The model read all four source files, made several verified but incorrect edits, and then entered rejected read/write plus catalog-search cycles. The no-progress policy stopped the attempt after 215.218 Agent seconds; evaluator reward was 0.0 and the strict audit was valid.
implementation_evidence.counterfactual_scope: A structurally unrelated report-formatter crash instruction receives the finite pre-edit and post-edit command workflow. A non-code git terminal instruction does not receive the code workflow, while command routing remains available.
implementation_evidence.model_choice_contract: The prompt tells the model when execution evidence is required but does not select a command, argv, working directory, file, edit, or tool call. Every action and argument must still come from the captured model response.
implementation_evidence.ruff: changed source and tests passed lint and format checks
implementation_evidence.project_layout: passed, including generic deployment leakage scan and canonical links
implementation_evidence.osworld_evaluator_tree: frozen commit with zero tracked changes

selection.method: targeted A/B for the current first non-pass ledger task
